scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker -c green,yellow "npm run start -w api" "npm run worker -w api"
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis elasticsearch
